tiles.title: Total Traces
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT span_trace_id) AS value FROM $traces_dataset

tiles.title: Total Spans
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM $traces_dataset

tiles.title: Error Spans
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_status_code = 2

tiles.title: P95 Span Latency
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS value FROM $traces_dataset

tiles.title: Total Logs
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM $logs_dataset

tiles.title: Error & Warning Logs
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM $logs_dataset WHERE severity_text IN ('ERROR','WARN','WARNING') OR p_log_category IN ('ERROR','WARN','WARNING')

tiles.title: Active Services
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "service.name") AS value FROM $traces_dataset

tiles.title: Unique Metrics
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT metric_name) AS value FROM $metrics_dataset

tiles.title: Span Volume by Service
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin, service_name
ORDER BY time_bin, service_name

tiles.title: Error Spans Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS errors
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin, service_name
ORDER BY time_bin, service_name

tiles.title: Service Error Rate
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY service_name
ORDER BY error_rate_pct DESC

tiles.title: P95 Latency by Service
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY service_name
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Service Health Summary
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COUNT(*) AS spans,
  COUNT(DISTINCT span_trace_id) AS traces,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS errors,
  ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 2) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY service_name
ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: Service Instance Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COALESCE("service.instance.id", 'unknown') AS instance_id,
  COALESCE("service.version", 'unknown') AS version,
  COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') AS environment,
  COUNT(*) AS spans,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY service_name, instance_id, version, environment
ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: HTTP Traffic by Method
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("http.method", 'unknown') AS method,
  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "http.method" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY method
ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: HTTP Status Mix
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("http.status_code", 'unknown') AS status_code,
  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "http.status_code" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY status_code
ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: HTTP P95 Latency by Route
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("http.target", 'unknown') AS route,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms,
  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "http.target" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
LIMIT 25

tiles.title: HTTP Server Throughput
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COUNT(*) AS requests
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE span_kind_description = 'SERVER' AND "http.method" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time_bin, service_name
ORDER BY time_bin, service_name

tiles.title: Slow HTTP Spans
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  "http.method" AS method,
  "http.target" AS route,
  "http.status_code" AS status_code,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 2) AS duration_ms,
  span_trace_id
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "http.method" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY span_duration_ns DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Database Calls Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE("db.operation", 'unknown') AS db_operation,
  COUNT(*) AS calls
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "db.operation" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time_bin, db_operation
ORDER BY time_bin, db_operation

tiles.title: Database Latency by Operation
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("db.operation", 'unknown') AS db_operation,
  COUNT(*) AS calls,
  ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 2) AS avg_ms,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "db.operation" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY db_operation
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Database Errors by Operation
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("db.operation", 'unknown') AS db_operation,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2 OR "event_db.error_message" IS NOT NULL) AS errors
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "db.operation" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY db_operation
ORDER BY errors DESC

tiles.title: Slow Database Spans
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  "db.system" AS db_system,
  "db.operation" AS db_operation,
  "db.name" AS db_name,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 2) AS duration_ms,
  span_status_code,
  span_trace_id
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "db.operation" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY span_duration_ns DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Cache Operations by Service
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COALESCE("cache.operation", 'unknown') AS cache_operation,
  COUNT(*) AS operations
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "cache.operation" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY service_name, cache_operation
ORDER BY operations DESC

tiles.title: Trace Cache Hit Rate
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "cache.hit" = true) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS hit_rate_pct
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "cache.hit" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY service_name
ORDER BY hit_rate_pct DESC

tiles.title: Dependency Calls
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("peer.service", 'unknown') AS dependency,
  COUNT(*) AS calls
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "peer.service" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dependency
ORDER BY calls DESC

tiles.title: Dependency P95 Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("peer.service", 'unknown') AS dependency,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms,
  COUNT(*) AS calls
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "peer.service" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dependency
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Dependency Errors
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("peer.service", 'unknown') AS dependency,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS errors
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "peer.service" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dependency
ORDER BY errors DESC

tiles.title: Messaging Operations
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("messaging.operation", span_name, 'unknown') AS operation,
  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "messaging.operation" IS NOT NULL OR "messaging.system" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY operation
ORDER BY spans DESC
LIMIT 20

tiles.title: Messaging Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("messaging.operation", span_name, 'unknown') AS operation,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE "messaging.operation" IS NOT NULL OR "messaging.system" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY operation
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: DNS & TLS Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT span_name AS operation,
  COUNT(*) AS spans,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE span_name IN ('dns.resolve', 'tls.handshake')
GROUP BY span_name
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Log Volume by Service
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE("service.name", service, 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COUNT(*) AS logs
FROM $logs_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin, service_name
ORDER BY time_bin, service_name

tiles.title: Log Severity Distribution
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category, 'unknown') AS severity,
  COUNT(*) AS logs
FROM $logs_dataset
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY logs DESC

tiles.title: Error Logs Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE("service.name", service, 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE severity_text IN ('ERROR','WARN','WARNING') OR p_log_category IN ('ERROR','WARN','WARNING')
GROUP BY time_bin, service_name
ORDER BY time_bin, service_name

tiles.title: Errors by Service
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", service, 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE severity_text IN ('ERROR','WARN','WARNING') OR p_log_category IN ('ERROR','WARN','WARNING')
GROUP BY service_name
ORDER BY errors DESC

tiles.title: Top Error Messages
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT body,
  COALESCE("service.name", service, 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE severity_text = 'ERROR' OR p_log_category = 'ERROR'
GROUP BY body, service_name
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Recent Error Logs
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  COALESCE("service.name", service, 'unknown') AS service_name,
  COALESCE(severity_text, p_log_category, 'unknown') AS severity,
  body,
  trace_id,
  span_id
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE severity_text IN ('ERROR','WARN','WARNING') OR p_log_category IN ('ERROR','WARN','WARNING')
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Log Code Locations
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("code.function.name", 'unknown') AS function_name,
  COALESCE("code.file.path", 'unknown') AS file_path,
  COALESCE("code.line.number", 'unknown') AS line_number,
  COUNT(*) AS logs
FROM $logs_dataset
GROUP BY function_name, file_path, line_number
ORDER BY logs DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Spans by Kind
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(span_kind_description, 'unknown') AS span_kind,
  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY span_kind_description
ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: Top Operations
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(span_name, 'unknown') AS operation,
  COUNT(*) AS spans,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY operation
ORDER BY spans DESC
LIMIT 25

tiles.title: Trace Latency Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.50), 2) AS p50_ms,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY time_bin
ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Recent Trace Summary
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT span_trace_id,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS start_time,
  COUNT(*) AS spans,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS errors,
  ROUND(MAX(span_duration_ns) / 1000000.0, 2) AS max_span_ms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "service.name") AS services
FROM $traces_dataset
GROUP BY span_trace_id
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Slowest Spans
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  span_name,
  span_kind_description,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 2) AS duration_ms,
  span_status_code,
  span_trace_id
FROM $traces_dataset
ORDER BY span_duration_ns DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Recent Error Spans
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,
  COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service_name,
  span_name,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 2) AS duration_ms,
  COALESCE("event_exception.message", span_status_message, span_status_description) AS error_message,
  span_trace_id
FROM $traces_dataset
WHERE span_status_code = 2
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Metric Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT metric_name,
  metric_type,
  metric_unit,
  COUNT(*) AS samples,
  COUNT(DISTINCT __series_hash_u64) AS series,
  MIN(p_timestamp) AS first_seen,
  MAX(p_timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM $metrics_dataset
GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit
ORDER BY samples DESC
